Title: ARK mzML inventory
Prompt: You have access to mzML files in the workspace at data/metabolomics/ark_mzml/. Load the positive-mode files (Ark_Roo_7uL_pos.mzML and Ark_Pev_7uL_pos.mzML) using matchms or pyopenms, and report: (1) number of spectra per file, (2) precursor m/z range, (3) retention time range in minutes. Print results as a JSON dict.
Notes: ARK Rooibos+Perilla HRMS; sanity check task

Title: ARK shared precursor ions
Prompt: Load the two positive-mode ARK files (Ark_Roo_7uL_pos.mzML and Ark_Pev_7uL_pos.mzML) using matchms. Extract MS2 spectra. Identify the top-10 most abundant precursor ions shared between both files (by m/z within 5 ppm tolerance). Report a table with m/z values and approximate retention times.
Notes: Cross-sample feature alignment mini-task; no MZmine needed

Title: ARK MS2 cosine similarity
Prompt: Using the matchms library, load Ark_Roo_7uL_pos.mzML from the workspace at data/metabolomics/ark_mzml/. Extract MS2 spectra with precursor m/z between 200-300 Da. Compute cosine similarity between all pairs. Report: (1) the pair with highest cosine score, including their precursor m/z values and score, (2) total number of MS2 spectra in the range.

Title: Rooibos metabolomics literature review
Prompt: Search Perspicacité for scientific literature on 'rooibos metabolomics circadian'. Summarize: (1) which metabolite classes are most studied, (2) what analytical methods are typically used, (3) any known circadian effects on rooibos metabolome. Return a structured summary.
Notes: Perspicacité grounding test — pure literature query; no local data needed

Title: ARK negative-mode MS2 count
Prompt: Load the negative-mode ARK files (Ark_Roo_7uL_neg.mzML and Ark_Pev_7uL_neg.mzML) from the workspace at data/metabolomics/ark_mzml/. Extract MS2 spectra with precursor m/z between 150-500 Da and at least 5 fragment ions. Count them and report the distribution by file and polarity.
Notes: MS2 fragment counting — tests mzML parsing and filtering
